newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaha signs OEM contract with Xicor on chips.
newsitem.headline: Yamaha signs OEM contract with Xicor on chips.

text.p: Yamaha Corp said on Thursday it had signed an original equipment manufacturing (OEM) contract with Xicor Inc of the United States to make semiconductor chips for the U.S. firm.
Yamaha said it would start producing erasable programmable read-only memory (EPROM) chips in Japan in early 1998.
The deal will provide Xicor with a stable supply of chips while allowing Yamaha to acquire technology to develop large-scale intergrated circuit chips, a Yamaha statement said.
EPROM chips, which can be programmed only by a special device and not by the computer or device in which it resides, are used in such products as cellular phones, the statement said.
